title: ID0412852-DC/Si-D/NO [MP / RD 170003111] Transaction pending
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Transaction pending on the charger.
Root cause: Transaction stuck due to Preauthorization limit reached
Solution: Delete transaction manually via SSH
